result.note: Mainly a company announcement; tested only the onshore data-processing angle and NPCI's role as UPI operator.

questions.prompt: In October 2026, Anthropic began processing Claude AI requests inside India. Consider the following statements:
items: The onshore processing is delivered through Google Cloud infrastructure.
The National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI), which operates the UPI network, is building its AI platform on Claude.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 1 is wrong because the story says the processing runs via AWS, not Google Cloud. The move targets banks and public bodies that need their data kept onshore.
questions.source: NPCI, the operator of India’s UPI payments network, is building its AI platform on Claude.
